label: all cases
query_or_path: entity = "case" and project = "DEVX"

label: cases per automation
query_or_path: SELECT (automation, COUNT(*)) entity = "case" and project = "DEVX" GROUP BY automation

label: cases per priority
query_or_path: SELECT (priority, COUNT(*)) entity = "case" and project = "DEVX" GROUP BY priority

label: distinct executed caseIds
query_or_path: SELECT (COUNT(id)) entity = "result" and project = "DEVX" GROUP BY caseId

label: unfiled cases
query_or_path: entity = "case" and project = "DEVX" and suite is empty

label: suiteTree scoping
query_or_path: entity = "case" and project = "DEVX" and suiteTree = "tests/api/pipelines"

label: staleness
query_or_path: entity = "case" and project = "DEVX" and updated <= now("-6m")

label: status distribution in window
query_or_path: SELECT (status, COUNT(*)) entity = "result" and project = "DEVX" and ended >= now("-12m") GROUP BY status

label: flake candidates
query_or_path: SELECT (caseId, COUNT(*)) entity = "result" and project = "DEVX" and status = "failed" and ended >= now("-12m") GROUP BY caseId HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

label: pass/fail split by caseId
query_or_path: SELECT (caseId, status, COUNT(*)) entity = "result" and project = "DEVX" and caseId in (16713, 16677) and ended >= now("-12m") GROUP BY caseId, status

label: duration aggregates
query_or_path: SELECT (caseId, AVG(timeSpent), MIN(timeSpent), MAX(timeSpent), COUNT(*)) entity = "result" and project = "DEVX" and caseId in (16713, 16677) and ended >= now("-12m") GROUP BY caseId

label: isFlaky flag
query_or_path: entity = "case" and project = "DEVX" and isFlaky = true

label: latest failed run
query_or_path: entity = "run" and project = "DEVX" and status = "failed" ORDER BY started DESC

label: run by id
query_or_path: entity = "run" and project = "DEVX" and id = 895

label: case history by caseId
query_or_path: entity = "result" and project = "DEVX" and caseId = 234 ORDER BY ended DESC

label: open defects
query_or_path: entity = "defect" and project = "DEVX" and status = "Open"

label: any defects at all
query_or_path: entity = "defect" and project = "DEVX"

label: requirements by status
query_or_path: SELECT (status, COUNT(*)) entity = "requirement" and project = "DEVX" GROUP BY status

label: priority critical is invalid
query_or_path: entity = "case" and project = "DEVX" and priority = "critical"

label: case.suite takes a title not an id
query_or_path: entity = "case" and project = "DEVX" and suite = 1

label: run has no created field
query_or_path: entity = "run" and project = "DEVX" ORDER BY created DESC

label: result has no created field
query_or_path: entity = "result" and project = "DEVX" and created >= now("-30d")

label: result has no run-id field
query_or_path: entity = "result" and project = "DEVX" and runId = 253

label: run status active is invalid
query_or_path: entity = "run" and project = "DEVX" and status = "active"

label: SELECT after conditions is rejected
query_or_path: entity = "result" and project = "DEVX" SELECT (COUNT(id)) GROUP BY status

label: suite listing with cases_count
query_or_path: suite/DEVX?limit=100

label: run listing with stats
query_or_path: run/DEVX?limit=100

label: results scoped to a run
query_or_path: result/DEVX?run=895&status=failed&limit=100

label: defects
query_or_path: defect/DEVX?limit=100

label: open defects
query_or_path: defect/DEVX?limit=100&status=open

label: system field enum options
query_or_path: system_field
